subject: Sprint gates & evaluation rubric — pilot kickoff readiness
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@nexera.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint gates & evaluation rubric — pilot kickoff readiness

Tom,

Thanks again for a focused call this morning — appreciated the clear framing of the business problem and the constraints your team is operating under. Below is a concise recap and an operational plan to get the 30-day pilot started. If anything below looks off, please reply with edits and we'll incorporate them into the kickoff doc.

Key pain we heard
- Customer service triage is slow: high volume of standard requests drifting to tier-2.
- Current latency for contextual search + heuristics is inconsistent; agents are dropping context.
- Cost concerns for a production LLM route; Nexera needs predictable unit economics.

Pilot goal (30 days)
- Demonstrate 40% reduction in mean handle time on a prioritized use case (ticket triage) while maintaining response precision >= 85% on our evaluation prompt set.
- Meet infra constraints: p95 latency < 250ms for single-turn queries; sustain 200 requests/min peak.

Scope (what we'll deliver during pilot)
- Integration: Redwood hosted runtime (dedicated capacity) linked to Nexera staging S3 for prompt datastore.
- Prompt set: We will run the attached sample_prompt_set.csv (40 prompts) across baseline model and Redwood-optimized variant.
- Eval: Weekly automated prompt/eval runs; human-in-the-loop check at day 14.
- Observability: Console access to per-route latency and token cost; daily telemetry snapshot.

Success metrics and acceptance gates
- Functional: Top-1 precision >= 85% on eval prompt set (automated) AND stakeholder signoff on 10 blind samples.
- Performance: p95 <= 250ms, CPU/GPU utilization within dedicated pool targets.
- Cost: Token cost per processed ticket <= agreed threshold (we'll surface per-token and per-minute cost in Console).

Owners (roles & primary contacts)
- Account exec / sponsor: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — commercial/reqs
- Solution engineer (implementation): Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com) — access, model configs, observability dashboards
- Customer PM / technical lead: Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@nexera.io) — data lane, S3 creds, approval on eval samples
- Customer ops: Ava Solutions procurement (procurement@avasolutions.com) — contract/PO coordination

Timeline (high-level)
- Week 0 (this week): Access & environment (S3 keys, allowlist, test account), baseline data sanity checks
- Week 1: Model variants deployed, first eval run on prompt set, short feedback loop
- Week 2: Prompt tuning and caching rules; mid-pilot blind review by Nexera leads
- Week 4: Consolidated evaluation, acceptance decision, and optional extension planning

Access / setup checklist (items we need from Nexera)
1) Staging S3 bucket & read-only IAM user or signed URLs for sample payloads
2) IP allowlist entries for Redwood egress (will share IP set)
3) Example support tickets export (CSV, last 90 days) — redacted PII OK
4) Decision on whether to run on Dedicated capacity (recommended) or hosted burst

Attachments: pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx (detailed tasks & owners), sample_prompt_set.csv, sd_access_checklist.pdf

Proposed next steps
- Tom: confirm access items 1–3 + preference on Dedicated vs Hosted by EOD Wed (18 Apr).
- Ben / Kimberly / Grace: schedule 60m kickoff for Thurs the 19th — I’ll propose slots after we hear back.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@nexera.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sprint gates & evaluation rubric — pilot kickoff readiness

Grace — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) We can provide a staging S3 bucket and a read-only service account by Wednesday morning (we'll send creds via the sd_access_checklist secure route).
2) Procurement (Ava Solutions) needs a short SOW before they can approve Dedicated capacity; they asked for a cost estimate by 18 Apr. Ben — can you share a one-page cost summary?
3) Performance ask: we'd like to target p95 < 200ms if Dedicated is enabled. If that requires changes to the eval plan, flag them.

We also have a compliance review scheduled on Friday — they may request that logs be rotated every 30 days.

Confirming the kickoff — Thurs 19th morning works for our team.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Product Lead — Automation
Nexera Systems

- Cost one-pager (Ben) — drive link
